policy: Never silently relax original constraints. Surface only conflicts relevant to current request; unaffected work continues.

items.conflict: Original quotas can produce formulaic prose, but are explicit.
items.default: Keep R05/R13/R19/R20/R24/R30. Final flow diagnoses awkwardness and routes scoped repair; user decides changes to rules.

items.conflict: Some historical examples use banned abstraction, fragments, forbidden words, hype or guaranteed outcomes.
items.default: Current explicit house style and audience no-guarantees rule outrank example wording; write new examples.

items.conflict: Source asks for 80,000 professionals/9,500 reviews and supplies unverified first-person examples.
items.default: Keep required hook authority slot; ask for approved current claim or mark exact placeholder. Never fabricate or silently delete the requirement.

items.conflict: Ten magnets listed but total nine; built-asset claims conflict; all Draft.
items.default: Inventory only. Confirm chosen actual contents and live/free destination before claiming download.

items.conflict: Audience course includes swipe file; curiosity masterclass explicitly lacks one.
items.default: Require product identity for any such offer claim.

items.conflict: 50–70 words and under 25 seconds may conflict at natural speech pace.
items.default: Report both observations; do not claim measured timing from word count or silently change targets.

items.conflict: One-in-three signpost limit unspecified for fewer than three signposts; approximate placement tolerances unspecified.
items.default: Report counts/positions and flag applicability. Do not invent hard rounding/window rules.

items.conflict: No repeated pain/result wording versus required callbacks.
items.default: Repeat referent with new wording; preserve genuine callback and rule. If exact phrase repetition is essential request exception.

items.conflict: One central point versus multi-step frameworks.
items.default: One central argument, one subpoint per section; retain necessary teaching steps.

items.conflict: No mechanism in promises versus teaching mechanism clearly.
items.default: Apply prohibition to signposts/promises; explain method in teaching body.

items.conflict: Optional story, repeated client signals/CTAs and next-video close may not fit a narrow edit/course format.
items.default: Preserve full-script rules for full scripts. For narrow edits evaluate document-wide constraints read-only and change only requested scope; flag format-specific uncertainty before imposing promotional defaults.

items.conflict: Missing evidence for required client signals, next video or magnet.
items.default: Block those spans with precise missing evidence; continue unrelated passes; final state cannot be ready with unsupported claims.

items.conflict: Source lines 10–12 give natural conversational quality priority over rules, except house style, while detailed quotas are explicit.
items.default: Preserve both statements. Attempt compliant scoped repair first; if irreconcilable, mark conflict and request explicit exception rather than silently dropping quotas or silently claiming the natural-flow goal no longer applies.
